notes: Stories refined for clear separation of schema, logic, integration, API exposure, and testing. Dependencies validated; no duplicates introduced.

change_log.value: Expanded schema to include normalized condition_match_score, eligibility_match_score, and composite relevance_score with explainability fields.

change_log.note: Ensure facade only depends on integrated service output

stories.title: Define Relevance Scoring Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define structured schema for trial relevance including condition_match_score, eligibility_match_score, composite relevance_score, and explainability fields. Extend Pydantic models for strict validation of inputs and outputs.

stories.title: Implement Condition and Eligibility Matching Logic
stories.description: Build core logic to compare user query intent against trial condition fields and eligibility criteria, including keyword matching, normalization, and partial match handling to produce structured relevance signals.

stories.title: Integrate Relevance Scoring into Clinical Trials Service Flow
stories.description: Embed relevance computation into clinical_trials_service pipeline so each trial result includes computed relevance signals prior to being returned upstream.

stories.title: Expose Relevance Signals via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate relevance scoring output into evaluate_care_facade responses so downstream consumers receive structured relevance indicators for each trial.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Relevance Matching Logic
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating condition matching, eligibility parsing, scoring accuracy, partial matches, and end-to-end service + facade integration including edge cases.
